messages:
Maria S (AE): Heads-up: POC with bank failing during live demo. Function-calls + json_mode=strict producing Invalid JSON intermittently; also getting 429s under load. Need quick unblock.
Ravi (Solutions): Customer summary: 'function_call returns truncated JSON (trailing comma or EOF) and then we see 429s with x-rate-limit-remaining:0 when we push ~30 clients.'
Casey (Runtime Eng): Can you paste one sanitized request/response and tell us model+streaming+concurrency?
Maria S (AE): They use redwood-large-v2, streaming=false, concurrency ~30 for demo. Sanitzed snippet: 
POST /v1/generate body: {"model":"redwood-large-v2","json_mode":"strict","function_call":{"name":"apply_tx"},"max_tokens":1500}
RESP 200 body: "\{\"tx\":\"abc\",\"status\":\"ok\",\"balance\":500, \}"  <-- trailing comma then EOF
Then later RESP 429 headers: x-request-id: demo-221, x-rate-limit-remaining:0

Devin (Oncall): Two independent things: (1) truncation -> likely chunking/early EOF during serializer flush, (2) 429 -> exceeded burst QPS. Short-term: reduce concurrency, add jittered exponential backoff.
Ravi (Solutions): Quick mitigations to propose to customer now: set json_mode to "lax" (accept partial JSON), reduce max_tokens to avoid large final chunk, or enable streaming=true and assemble chunks client-side. Also ask them to cap concurrency to <=10 for demo.
Casey (Runtime Eng): If Security signs off I can temporarily enable tolerant-json for their API key for 12h (auto-close EOF, allow trailing commas) and log all tolerant parses. Also can bump per-key QPS from 25->50 for 2h. Need exact x-request-id(s) to correlate logs.
Security Bot: Alert: "tolerant-json" increases parser risk. Approval required: short TTL, audit logging, demo-only key recommended.
Maria S (AE): Action items: 1) I'll ask customer to drop to <=10 concurrency and add jittered retries now. 2) Customer to repro and give x-request-id of a 429. 3) Casey/Devin to prepare temp tolerant-json + QPS bump plan pending Security OK. 4) Ravi to sketch Dedicated/Private cost options (KMS/HSM, VPC) for follow-up.
Casey (Runtime Eng): I'll also paste a tiny streaming assembly helper if they switch to streaming.
Maria S (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll post the x-request-id once I have it.
Devin (Oncall): Logged inc-2026-03-21-99. Will attach traces when we get the id.
